summary: A design or craft workshop is part of the organizer's announced Chiang Mai Design Week 2026 plans, scheduled for 5–13 December. However, the current official program page has no searchable individual listings, so a specific workshop, session date, participant booking, and price are not yet verified. Treat this as a promising festival possibility, not a guaranteed bookable class.
whyGo: A hands-on session could offer a more personal way to encounter Chiang Mai's contemporary design and craft community than exhibition browsing alone.
The organizer describes 2026 workshops and art activities for varied audiences, including families, younger people, and older participants.
bestFor: Travellers interested in making, local craft, or design practice.
Visitors with flexible dates who can choose a session after the full program appears.
skipIf: You need a confirmed class, medium, date, language, duration, or price before planning.
Your Chiang Mai dates fall outside 5–13 December 2026.
duration: Not published for any individual 2026 workshop. Allow at least a half-day in your schedule for travel and a potential session; this is a planning allowance, not an event duration.
cost: No participant price or general admission policy for workshops was found. Check the individual listing when published; budget separately for transport and any materials or purchases it specifies.
hours: Festival dates are 5–13 December 2026. Workshop hours and venue are not yet listed; events are distributed across Chiang Mai rather than held at one festival-wide venue.
bestTime: Choose a session that fits the final daily program and your preferred neighbourhood. No workshop date or time is confirmed yet.
gettingThere: The festival is citywide. The official program identifies neighbourhood filters including Chang Moi–Tha Phae, Old Town, Nimman–Wat Umong, Wat Ket–San Pa Khoi, and San Kamphaeng. Use the specific workshop venue address once published; allow for taxi or songthaew travel between areas.
booking: No participant registration or booking link for a specific workshop is currently listed. Monitor the official 2026 program and contact the organizer at hello.cmdw@cea.or.th or +66 52 080 500 ext. 312 to confirm dates, language, fees, places, and registration. Do not confuse vendor open calls with visitor workshop bookings.
accessibility: No workshop-specific accessibility details are published. Ask the organizer or venue about step-free entry, seating, toilets, materials, and language support before booking once a session is announced.
practicalTips: Recheck the official program close to your visit; the page currently returns no program listings despite the general workshop announcement.
Confirm whether the activity is open to visitors, whether registration is required, and whether materials are included.
Use the exact venue and schedule for the session rather than assuming it takes place at TCDC Chiang Mai.
decemberNotes: The organizer confirms the festival dates as 5–13 December 2026. The 2025 edition ran 6–14 December and its archive is marked as a past festival; its schedules cannot establish a 2026 workshop. Festival dates are verified, while a specific workshop during those dates is not yet individually scheduled in the published program.
uncertainties: No individually named or dated participant workshop appears in the official 2026 program at the time checked, although the organizer announces workshops in general.
Workshop venue, participant eligibility, booking process, capacity, price, duration, language, and accessibility remain unconfirmed.
